notes.note: PF3 return path: COTRTUPC transfers to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, or to the admin menu COADM01C when that field is empty. When the screen was opened from the list with PF2, COTRTLIC has put its own name in CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM before the XCTL, so PF3 returns to COTRTLIC. The diagram draws the raw candidates and does not show this hop; the dynamic-call annotation for COTRTUPC.cbl:457 records COTRTLIC as a derived target.

The SEND MAP that names its mapset through CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET sends map CTRTUPA of mapset COTRTUP: both writers of the item in COTRTUPC move LIT-THISMAPSET, whose VALUE is 'COTRTUP '. The mapset shown as unknown is this same screen, not a second one.
